findings.subject: textarea
findings.summary: No story or baseline renders Textarea right-to-left on main.
findings.fix: Add a RightToLeft story under UIProvider dir="rtl" with an RTL play check and a baseline.

findings.subject: input
findings.summary: Autofill is promised as a designed state but no autofill rule exists.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k03-form-6. apps/docs/src/pages/component-input.mdx:75-77; grep autofill over packages/styles/src and packages/ui-react/src CSS: 0 hits
findings.fix: Add an :autofill rule that keeps the field background and text on tokens, capture it, or drop the docs claim.

findings.subject: search-field, input-otp, autocomplete
findings.summary: These field controls stay 32px on coarse pointers; the 44px hit strip landed only on Input and the Select trigger.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k03-form-4 (input and select fixed). packages/ui-react/src/components/input/input.css:15,63-82 (.a63-Input only); input-otp/input-otp.css:40-44; autocomplete/autocomplete.css:36-40
findings.fix: Give .a63-InputGroup, the OTP slot row and the Autocomplete input the same ::before strip, and add them to check:control-alignment.

findings.subject: search-field, input-otp, autocomplete
findings.summary: Focus-visible (and for input-otp the contract current slot) is captured in no baseline for these three; Input, Textarea and Select now are.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k03-form-5 (input, textarea fixed). apps/storybook/.storybook/visual.setup.ts:55-102; packages/ui-react/src/components/search-field/search-field.stories.tsx, input-otp/input-otp.stories.tsx, autocomplete/autocomplete.stories.tsx (no visualState)
findings.fix: Add FocusVisible stories with parameters.visualState.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: AutocompleteInput bypasses the shared field tokens, so it diverges from Input and Select under themes that override --a63-field-*.
findings.fix: Read --a63-field-background/-border/-radius/-focus-border like Input.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: No APG combobox pattern binding and no keyboard test for Autocomplete.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k03-form-9. apps/storybook/a11y/patterns.test.ts (no autocomplete binding); packages/ui-react/src/components/autocomplete/autocomplete.test.tsx:44-130
findings.fix: Bind the combobox (list autocomplete) pattern and test ArrowDown, Enter, Escape.

findings.subject: select
findings.summary: One APG deviation remains: Base UI Select moves DOM focus to options instead of aria-activedescendant; it is documented as a known gap.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k03-form-10 (four of five gaps fixed in #351). packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/select.json:53-57
findings.fix: Track upstream; no local fix while Base UI has no option.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: No phone-width story with the popup open, so keyboard overlap and safe-area placement of the listbox are unverified (Select now has one).
findings.fix: Add a Phone story with the popup open under touch.

findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: The contract-required query state (value plus clear button) and invalid are never captured.
findings.fix: Add a story with defaultValue (clear visible) and an invalid case.

findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: No Themes story, so aqua, retro and terminal are never captured for SearchField.
findings.fix: Add a Themes story.

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: OTP slots mirror in RTL documents, so a typed code reads reversed.
findings.fix: Set direction: ltr on the slot row (codes are LTR) and add an RTL story.

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: OTP slots are 32px squares on coarse web pointers.
findings.fix: Floor the slot at --a63-control-min-target on coarse pointers, or add a hit strip.

findings.subject: amount
findings.summary: Amount without locale formats with the runtime locale, so server and browser output differ and hydration mismatches; the default path is untested.
findings.fix: Read the locale from UIProvider or require it for SSR; test the default path in the SSR project.

findings.subject: input, textarea, input-otp
findings.summary: No forced-colors rules: the invalid state (border colour only) and the OTP fake caret (background-color) vanish in forced colours.
findings.fix: Add forced-colors blocks (thicker or dashed invalid border, caret as border).

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: Slot emits data-active while the contract state is current; no invalid prop and no exported prop types.
findings.fix: Emit data-current, add invalid, export prop types.

findings.subject: input, textarea, search-field, field
findings.summary: States named focus and default are baselined synonyms of focus-visible and rest.
findings.fix: Rename the contract states and drop the baseline entries.

findings.subject: input
findings.summary: unstyled and shadow are boolean chrome modifiers beside the variant axis.
findings.fix: Decide whether they fold into variants.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: startAddon is always aria-hidden, the clear name API differs from SearchField's clearLabel, and the contract slot autocomplete-surface is not rendered (baselined).
findings.fix: Let startAddon opt out of aria-hidden, align clearLabel, emit data-slot="autocomplete-surface".

findings.subject: amount
findings.summary: strong is a weight axis not listed in the amount contract.
findings.fix: Add a weight axis to the contract or fold it.

findings.subject: amount
findings.summary: Themes baseline rows are unlabelled and terminal keeps the proportional face.
findings.fix: Label rows; YZ to decide on the terminal face.

findings.subject: label
findings.summary: Label dims when any later sibling is disabled, not only its own control.
findings.fix: Scope to the associated control (peer or :has(+ ...)).
